map.信息熵（香农）计算器。输入离散信源各符号概率，计算平均信息量 H（bit/符号）: Information Entropy (Shannon) Calculator. Enter the probabilities of the symbols of a discrete source to compute the average information H (bits per symbol); probabilities should sum to 1 and zero-probability terms count as 0. It is a basic metric for data compression and encryption strength analysis.
map.压缩下限：熵即无损压缩平均码长的理论下限。: Compression lower bound: entropy is the theoretical lower bound on the average code length of lossless compression.
map.随机性评估：高熵提示数据接近均匀分布、更\"随机\"。: Randomness assessment: a high entropy indicates the data is close to uniform and more "random".
map.密码学强度：密钥/ nonce 的熵衡量抗猜测能力。: Cryptographic strength: the entropy of a key or nonce measures resistance to guessing.
